test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct direct speech form of the following sentence.

They said that they had already completed their homework.

options.text: They said, "We already completed their homework."
They said, "We have completed our homework."
They said, "We have already completed homework of ours."
They said, "We have already completed our homework.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** They said that they had already completed their homework.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"they had already completed" becomes "we have already completed"**
 
 
• The past perfect tense "had already completed" is converted to present perfect tense "have already completed" in direct speech.
 
• Pronoun "they" is changed to "we" to reflect the perspective of the speaker.
 
• Possessive pronoun "their" is changed to "our" to match the speaker's point of view.
 
 
 
• **Punctuation:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed within quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "We" and ends with a period "." inside the quotation marks.
 
 
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "We already completed their homework."

 
 
• Incorrect possessive pronoun "their" instead of "our."
 
• Tense "already completed" is past simple, which is incorrect in direct speech here.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "We have completed our homework."
 
 
• Missing the word "already," which changes the meaning slightly.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "We have already completed homework of ours."
 
 
• Awkward phrasing with "homework of ours" instead of "our homework."
